name: temp-repo-cloner
description: Clone a repository into a temporary directory and delete it when closed.

scripts.install-extension: node -e "const p = require('./package.json'); const code = process.env.CODE_PATH || 'code'; console.log(code + ' --install-extension ' + p.name + '-' + p.version + '.vsix')" | sh
scripts.dev: npm run compile && npm run pack && npm run install-extension
